test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs to sequentially replace the @ signs and to balance the given equation.

72 @ 9 @3 @ 6 @ 6 @ 6 @ 6
solution:
Here, we use the BODMAS table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e10e3be1476caf1bd7e2e109842e7c57ce86da0c54b1b539e233e4e6a7748a44.png] 

Given:

⇒ 72 @ 9 @3 @ 6 @ 6 @ 6 @ 6

(1) ÷, ×, +, =, -, +

⇒ 72 @ 9 @3 @ 6 @ 6 @ 6 @ 6

After putting the signs:

⇒ __**72 ÷ 9**__ × 3 + 6 = 6 - 6 + 6

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 8 × 3 + 6 = 12 - 6

⇒ 24 + 6 = 6

⇒ 30 = 6

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

(2) **÷, ×, +, =, ×, -**

⇒ 72 @ 9 @3 @ 6 @ 6 @ 6 @ 6

After putting the signs:

⇒** __72 ÷ 9__** × 3 + 6 = __**6 × 6**__ - 6

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ __**8 × 3**__ + 6 = 36 - 6

⇒ 24 + 6 = 30

⇒ **30 = 30**

Here, the equation is **satisfied.**

(3) ×, ÷, =, -, +, ×

⇒ 72 @ 9 @3 @ 6 @ 6 @ 6 @ 6

After putting the signs:

⇒ 72 × __**9 ÷ 3**__ = 6 - 6 + __**6 × 6**__

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ __**72 × 3**__ = 6 - 6 + 36

⇒ 216 = 42 - 6

⇒ 216 = 36

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

(4) +. ×, =, -, ÷, +

⇒ 72 @ 9 @3 @ 6 @ 6 @ 6 @ 6

After putting the signs:

⇒ 72 + __**9 × 3**__ = 6 - __**6 ÷ 6**__ + 6

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 72 + 27 = 6 - 1 + 6

⇒ 99 = 12 - 1

⇒ 99 = 11

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (2)".
